blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — lurasidone food requirement
stem: Which instruction should the nurse give a client taking lurasidone tablets?

options.A: Take each lurasidone dose with food containing at least 350 calories because food substantially increases the medication's absorption.
options.B: Take lurasidone on an empty stomach because food decreases systemic exposure and can make the prescribed dose less predictable.
options.C: Take lurasidone with or without food because meals do not meaningfully change the amount of medication absorbed into the bloodstream.
options.D: Take lurasidone with clear liquids while avoiding solid food because calorie-containing meals interfere with gastrointestinal absorption.

rationale: Current lurasidone prescribing information states that lurasidone tablets should be taken with food containing at least 350 calories because administration with food substantially increases absorption. The label reports approximately a twofold increase in AUC and a threefold increase in Cmax with food. Therefore A is correct. B, C, and D directly contradict the labeled food requirement or direction of the food effect.
educational_objective: Teach clients to take lurasidone with at least 350 calories of food to ensure appropriate absorption.
source_organization: DailyMed (U.S. National Library of Medicine) / FDA labeling
source_document_title: LURASIDONE HYDROCHLORIDE tablets — Full Prescribing Information
source_version_date: Current 2026 DailyMed labeling verified and accessed 2026-08-26
source_locator: Dosage and Administration §2.3 Administration Information — take with food of at least 350 calories; food substantially increases absorption; Clinical Pharmacology §12.3.
source_claim_supported: Lurasidone tablets should be taken with food containing at least 350 calories because food substantially increases absorption; food increases AUC approximately twofold and Cmax approximately threefold.
blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies, printed p.12/PDF p.16: provide medication education and apply medication-administration principles.
candidate_reasons_resolved: Rewrote all four choices as complete administration instructions without the original absolute-word distractor pattern.
Length-balanced the options and preserved the exact 350-calorie food requirement and direction of the absorption effect.
audit_note: Independent adversarial review confirms A uniquely follows current lurasidone administration labeling. B–D are plausible administration statements but reverse or deny the food effect, and option length does not cue the key.
